summary: Parents argue that screen‑based instruction is harmful and demand the ability to opt out of such programs.

claims.requested_action: allow parent opt‑out of screen‑based instruction
claims.argument: Parents believe that excessive screen time harms children’s development and therefore should be able to opt out of such instruction.
claims.evidence_quote: As parents who have intentionally avoided screen time, we were truly shocked at how quickly public school was undermining our parenting by giving kindergartners 1:1 devices, iPads for choice time,
